TOL-REQUEST-STORE.name: SQLite request store
TOL-REQUEST-STORE.algorithm: Open a scoped SQLite connection, translate ready domain values to bound parameters, execute the conditional write, and translate the row/result into the abstract operation result without reimplementing entity invariants.
TOL-REQUEST-STORE.transaction: Use BEGIN IMMEDIATE for the uniqueness-sensitive write; commit only after the stored result is known and roll back on a known failure. Preserve unknown outcome when commit confirmation is lost.
notes: No automatic retry is permitted for unknown write outcomes.
